_comment: Describes this release to other installs. Read by the Version & Updates panel when an operator points their server at a URL serving this file. Generated from releases/<version>.md by scripts/build-release-json.js — edit the notes file, not this one.
notes: Upgrade as usual — this is a code-only release. There is no database migration and no Android rebuild: the app shell has not changed since v2.0.0, so the APK you built keeps working. If you installed a manual checkout and were told to check out a tag that did not exist, that is fixed here, and v2.0.0's tag has been published as well — either version is now reachable by tag. Two things worth knowing about a tag checkout: it leaves you on a detached HEAD, so the next upgrade is the same two commands with a newer tag; and if your clone predates this project being re-published, `git pull` will fail with `refusing to merge unrelated histories` — `git fetch origin && git reset --hard origin/main` is the way through (keep any local changes first).
